item.command:
/bin/bash -lc 'set -u
verify_tmp=$(find tmp -maxdepth 1 -type d -name '"'deosar-*' | head -1)
for url in 'https://highereducation.mp.gov.in/?orgid=460' 'http://highereducation.mp.gov.in/?orgid=460' 'https://highereducation.mp.gov.in/ClgProfile?orgid=460'; do
  name="'$(printf '"'%s' \""'$url" | sed '"'s#https\\?://##;s#[?=/]#_#g')
  out=\""'$verify_tmp/$name.html"
  curl -L --insecure --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 60 "$url" -o "$out" || true
